jobs.description:
Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!
 

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.
 

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:
 

 
• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
 
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations. 
 
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed. 
 
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly. 
 
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities. 

 
•  
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.
 
 
•  
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 
 
 
•  
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.
 
 
•  
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.
 
 
•  
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.
 
 
•  
You communicate well in English.
 
 
•  
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.
 
 
•  
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.
 
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

For the campus of DHL in Bornem, we are looking for order pickers with ETP experience and the necessary ETP certificate. You will work in a dynamic team, where you will work in the alternating shift (6 a.m. to 2 p.m. & 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.). 
 

As an order picker, your duties will include the following tasks: 
 

 
• Collecting/picking orders using a ETP
 
• Applying shipping labels to orders
 
• Loading and unloading trucks, this can be either manually or with an electric transpallet (ETP). 
 
• Taking care of administration: this may involve processing delivery notes 
 
• Quality control of goods dn packaging of goods.
 
• We are looking for order pickers who are keen to prove themselves across the warehouse and in any position. 

As an order picker, you can relate to the following description: 
 

 
• You already have experience in the logistics sector.
 
• You have your own transport to get to the warehouse. (Not accessible by public transport )
 
• You are enthusiastic about taking up a new challenge.
 
• You can perform your tasks accurately and correctly.
 
• A real team player.
 
• You are stress-resistant and always remain customer-friendly under difficult circumstances.
 
• You consider quality of paramount importance.
 
• A good basic knowledge of Dutch or English.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Follow-up on all administrative and compliance duties around the foundation’s activities (audit, accountancy, legal documentation) 
 
• In charge of following the day-to-day financial management: payments, transactions, documentation 
 
• Responsible of organizing team moments and agenda’s and travels 
 
• Operational support on organizing internal and external events and activities (boards, trainings, specific meetings) 
 
• In charge of adapting documentation and information tools  
 
• Enhancing procedures and infrastructure to support the foundation’s operations (CRM management Salesforce, financial monitoring) 

Profile:
 
 
 
• Organized, autonomous, proactive, versatile personality 
 
• Fluent in English, Dutch/French 
 
• Excellent communication skills 
 
• Good use of excel and easiness to understand and work with digital management tools such as Trello, Salesforce, remote working tools 
 
• Good understanding of financial management and accountancy

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Customs Coordinator | West-Flanders Area
jobs.description:
Our client is a long-established industrial manufacturer with production sites in Belgium and abroad, supplying high-performance chemical solutions. Supported by private equity investors, the organisation is evolving from a traditional setup towards a more modern, performance-driven operating model. The company is located in the North of the province of West Flanders.

Jobomschrijving

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator will:

• Become a key member of a team of five customer service professionals, managing the complete order-to-cash process for an international B2B customer portfolio.
• Oversee and manage customs documentation and trade compliance activities for international import and export transactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, building strong relationships and ensuring an excellent service experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.
• Proactively manage customer enquiries, orders, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics, production, and sales teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments.
• Collaborate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to facilitate smooth and compliant cross-border shipments.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital transformation projects, helping modernise processes and enhance customer service efficiency.

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator we are looking for has:

• At least 3 years of experience in customer service, order management, logistics coordination and/or customs within an international B2B environment.
• A genuine customer-centric mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP is a strong asset).
• Knowledge of customs processes and international trade compliance requirements.
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French and/or German are considered an advantage.
• The flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a changing environment and support process improvements.

Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.Customer Service Excellence

• Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
• Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
• Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
• Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
• Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.
Compliance & Documentation

• Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
• Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
• Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
• Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
• Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
• Professional level in Dutch, French and English

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Jobomschrijving

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
• You are available for a full-time position.

📋 Tasks and responsibilities

The central warehouse in Hoboken supports site operations for goods receipt, storage, shipment coordination and the repair flow of materials. Warehouse administration is managed largely in SAP, including Warehouse Management, Inventory Management and Materials Management.

A recent software go-live is still being embedded in daily operations. To support the warehouse transformation linked to the MAG41 building situation, a temporary project structure has been set up with a part-time Senior Project Manager and a full-time Project Management Officer. In this role, you handle day-to-day coordination, planning, follow-up, documentation and reporting for the project.

You work under the direction of the Senior Project Manager. Operational and line-management responsibilities remain within the warehouse organization. This is a hands-on coordination role in an operational and technical environment, with ownership of project follow-up rather than a purely administrative PMO focus.

• Project planning and follow-upTranslate the remediation scope and warehouse transformation objectives into an integrated project plan with scope, workstreams, deliverables, milestones, owners, resources, dependencies and decision points.
• Consolidate the handover from the initial action phase into the integrated project plan, including ongoing interventions, contractor activities, technical findings, costs, risks, decisions and open actions.
• Maintain the master planning and align technical works, safety measures, operational constraints, material relocations and other workstreams.
• Follow up actions and deliverables from internal stakeholders, engineering partners, contractors and temporary support providers.
• Track progress across workstreams, maintain a structured overview of actions, risks, decisions and open issues, and escalate where needed.
• Prepare and document project and steering meetings, including agenda, presentations, minutes and action points.
• Budget and reportingMaintain the project budget, commitments, actual costs, forecasts and WBS follow-up in cooperation with controlling.
• Build and maintain project reporting on progress, milestones, budget, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies and operational impact.
• Perform quality checks on project documentation and reports.
• Stakeholder management and communicationAct as the central coordination point for project information between the Senior Project Manager, workstreams, warehouse representatives, technical departments, EHS, controlling, procurement and external partners.
• Prepare consolidated reporting and decision-support material for the Senior Project Manager and Steering Committee.
• Set up and maintain a clear communication rhythm towards stakeholders and management.
• Operational impact and coordinationMonitor the impact of project activities on warehouse operations and ensure that constraints, risks and mitigation actions are reflected in the project plan.
• Coordinate project-related requirements with warehouse representatives, field coaches and other internal stakeholders.
• Plan and follow up the deployment of ad hoc operational support within the agreed project governance.
• Coordinate relocations, temporary material flows and access requirements linked to the project, without taking line responsibility for warehouse operations.
• Escalate conflicts between project execution and operational continuity to the Senior Project Manager.

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a PMO Officer or Project Coordinator.
• You bring proven experience in warehousing, logistics or supply chain projects, such as warehouse reorganization, capacity improvement or a system go-live.
• You have experience in an industrial project organization, for example in production, chemicals, metals or a comparable environment.
• You have experience with project-level budget follow-up, cost tracking, reporting and KPI dashboards.
• You work confidently with MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with MS Planner or similar project management tools is an advantage.
• Knowledge of SAP, in particular WM, IM and MM, is a strong plus.
• You combine a hands-on project mindset with a structured way of working and can switch smoothly between detailed follow-up, stakeholder coordination, contractor interaction, reporting and escalation.
• You are able to maintain clear boundaries between project coordination and operational line responsibility.
• You work effectively with limited supervision and know how to prepare issues proactively for decision-making or escalation.
• You stay calm under pressure, bring structure in situations with limited capacity and handle multiple parallel tasks effectively.
• You have strong organizational, planning, analytical and stakeholder management skills, from operators to management.
• You are a quick learner, self-starter and act with discretion and integrity.
• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in logistics, supply chain, business administration or engineering, or you bring equivalent experience.
• Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA is a plus.
• Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma is a plus.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch for daily contact with the warehouse team and have a good command of English.
• You are available for full-time onsite work in Hoboken, unless agreed otherwise.

📋 Tasks and responsibilities

The central warehouse in Hoboken supports site operations through goods receipt, storage, shipment coordination and the repair flow of materials. Warehouse administration is largely managed in SAP, including Warehouse Management, Inventory Management and Materials Management.

A recent system go-live is still being embedded into daily operations. At the same time, the warehouse is going through a temporary transformation linked to the MAG41 building situation. In this context, a Senior Project Manager will take the lead on the overall project structure and coordination.

This role combines building remediation, safety and operational continuity with improvements in warehouse capacity, organization, processes and systems. You lead the project governance, coordinate the different workstreams and steer the Project Management Officer. You consolidate project status and report progress, risks, decisions and recommendations to the Steering Committee.

At the start of the assignment, you ensure a structured handover of ongoing interventions, contractor commitments, technical findings, costs, risks, decisions and open actions into one integrated project framework.

Primary tasks and responsibilities

• Set up and chair the project governance, including steering committee meetings, workstream meetings, decision lines and escalation paths.
• Define roles and responsibilities between warehouse management, PMO, operational support and other stakeholders.
• Translate remediation needs, technical findings and warehouse transformation objectives into an integrated scope with clear workstreams, deliverables, priorities, milestones and decision points.
• Validate and steer the integrated project plan, ensuring alignment between timing, resources, dependencies and operational constraints.
• Coordinate workstreams covering building remediation, safety, operational continuity, temporary material flows and relocations, warehouse capacity and layout, processes and organization, and system embedding.
• Monitor the operational impact of project activities and align mitigation measures, resources and decision points with the relevant stakeholders.
• Steer the Project Management Officer and review planning, budget and WBS follow-up, risk and issue management, reporting and stakeholder communication.
• Determine, together with the PMO and operational stakeholders, when additional support is needed and integrate that support into the project planning.
• Oversee budget, commitments, actual costs, forecasts and WBS follow-up, including external contractor costs and temporary support, in cooperation with controlling.
• Identify risks and issues early and propose mitigation actions.
• Provide concise, decision-oriented reporting on progress, budget, risks, dependencies, required decisions and recommendations.
• Align with operations, supply chain, procurement, IT and business applications, EHS, controlling and external partners.
• Ensure all project actions comply with EHS standards on an active industrial site.
• Leave behind a documented and transferable project structure at the end of the assignment.
Key deliverables

• An integrated project scope, governance structure, roadmap and master plan for the MAG41 remediation and warehouse transformation.
• A consolidated technical and operational baseline following the initial actions and further investigations.
• Documented safety and operational continuity measures for the different project phases.
• Evaluated scenarios for remediation, redevelopment and, where relevant, alternative storage or operating arrangements.
• A recommended solution including scope, risks, budget, phasing and operational impact.
• A decision package and roadmap for the subsequent implementation or capital project phase.

• You have at least 10 years of experience in project or programme management, with a strong track record in warehousing, logistics, supply chain operations or industrial transformation projects within an industrial or production environment.
• You have proven experience in setting up governance and leading multiple workstreams in operational change projects such as warehouse reorganization, capacity expansion or a WMS/ERP implementation.
• You are able to stabilize operations under pressure while running a project in parallel, for example in a crisis or turnaround context.
• You have a solid understanding of warehouse processes, including inbound, storage, internal supply, outbound, inventory control and repair or return flows.
• Knowledge of SAP logistics modules such as WM/EWM, IM and MM is an advantage.
• Experience with capacity analysis, warehouse layout and material flows is a plus.
• Experience with budget follow-up at project or cost-center level is a plus.
• You work comfortably with MS Project or an equivalent planning tool, MS Excel and PowerPoint. Power BI is a plus.
• Knowledge of EHS standards and good practices on an industrial site is an asset.
• You bring structure and calm in a team working under pressure.
• You can prioritize sharply and work effectively within a limited time budget.
• You lead without formal hierarchy and can coach junior or medior project staff.
• You communicate clearly with both operational teams and management.
• You combine a pragmatic, hands-on approach with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• You support change in an environment that has recently gone live with a new system.
• You work autonomously with limited supervision.
• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or a related field, or you bring equivalent experience.
• A project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA is a plus.
• Lean or Six Sigma certification, for example Green Belt, is a plus.
• Site safety certification such as VCA is to be confirmed.
• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good to fluent command of English, both written and spoken.
• You are available to work on site in Hoboken on project days.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

• 
You will drive and operate the Terberg truck for goods handling and truck operations.

 
• 
You will drive the trailers to the loading and unloading docks and transport them within the industrial park.

 
• 
Ensure safe and efficient internal transport of goods.

 
• 
You will sometimes assist in the warehouse: loading, unloading, receiving, driving the forklift.

 
•
